career_risk_cards.callout: The risks for air crew officers are not AI but selection, health, and transition. Managing capability, physical condition, and post-service planning together is essential to a complete career strategy.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's primary risks are selection and attrition. Flight and command officers face exceptionally high physical, psychological, academic, and training requirements, with strict screening and high attrition. Careers also depend on military staffing and service cycles, making transition preparation important.
risks: Selection attrition: exceptionally demanding recruitment and training
Physical pressure: flight loads and health management
Mission risk: the inherent safety demands of flight
Service cycle: career paths depend on military staffing
Transition barrier: skill transfer after service requires planning

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate risk probabilities, but it cannot issue the order to proceed or withdraw. People must always carry command responsibility.

career_risk_cards.callout: 空勤军官的风险不在 AI，而在「选拔、身体和转型」——把能力、健康与退役规划一起管理好，才是完整的职业观。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要是「选拔与淘汰」：飞行和指挥军官对身体、心理、学历和训练要求极高，筛选严格、淘汰率高；同时职业受编制和服役周期约束，需按军官职业规划发展，退役时要有转型准备。
risks: 选拔淘汰：招飞与训练要求极高
身体压力：飞行负荷与健康管理
任务风险：飞行本身的安全属性
服役周期：职业路径受编制约束
转型门槛：退役后技能转换需规划

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 算得出风险概率，下不了「进还是撤」的命令——指挥的责任，永远要人来扛。

career_path_block.说明: Vulnerable to replacement by AI processing tools

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for Earth science teachers is not AI but competition for faculty roles and funding anxiety. AI changes research methods, but it does not soften the demands of an academic career.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but competition for faculty roles and evaluation pressure. Earth science positions are limited, up-or-out systems are demanding, and research funding is highly competitive. Long fieldwork cycles and slow publication timelines add pressure for early-career scholars.
risks: Scarce faculty roles: few openings and up-or-out systems
Funding competition: research grants are increasingly difficult to secure
Demanding fieldwork: long expeditions with real risks
Output pressure: papers take a long time to produce
Moderate income: generally lower than industry pay

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can process data and draft reviews for teachers, but only the person at the front of the classroom can provide the curiosity and judgment needed to ask what lies behind a phenomenon.

responsibilities: Participate in observation programs, fieldwork, and academic program development
skills: Interdisciplinary collaboration and public science communication

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 处理工具替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 地学教师最大的风险不是 AI，而是「教职竞争与经费焦虑」——AI 改变的是研究方式，改变不了学术赛道的残酷。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「教职竞争与考核压力」——地学方向教职岗位有限，非升即走压力大；科研经费竞争激烈，野外考察周期长、成果产出慢，年轻学者处境并不轻松。
risks: 教职稀缺：岗位少、非升即走
经费竞争：科研基金越来越难拿
野外辛劳：考察周期长风险有
成果压力：论文产出周期慢
收入一般：相对产业界偏低

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能替教师跑数据、写综述，但「这个现象背后藏着什么」——那份对地球的好奇与判断，只有站在讲台上的人能给。

responsibilities: 参与观测考察与学科建设

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Computer hardware engineers lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk comes from high-risk exposure and unclear accountability, not AI. People remain responsible for Computer hardware engineers judgments and final review; AI handles only structured tasks.
risks: Pressure from accountability and compliance boundaries in computer hardware engineering.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split high risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute hardware engineering plans.
Accept responsibility for hardware quality and risk.
Coordinate resources and drive hardware project delivery.
Review and improve hardware engineering processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——计算机硬件工程师的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「高风险敞口 + 责任边界」——计算机硬件工程师的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Computer hardware engineers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把高风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Computer hardware engineers相关的工作方案。
对Computer hardware engineers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Computer hardware engineers项目交付。
复盘优化Computer hardware engineers流程与方法。

career_path_block.说明: Entry role with strong automation pressure
Combined hardware and software skills remain in strong demand

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is allowing skills to remain a decade behind. Technicians who test manually but cannot write scripts face automation. Embedded systems, automated testing, and integration skills gain value with experience.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is becoming an intermediate layer displaced by algorithms, not AI itself. Standardized wiring and testing are increasingly handled by automated test equipment and AI diagnostics. Workers must progress toward system testing, embedded systems, and automation.
risks: Automation: machines reduce repetitive assembly and testing roles
Rapid skill change: workers who ignore automation become marginalized
Project overtime: prototype and project deadlines create long hours
Environmental hazards: some testing settings involve radiation or electrostatic discharge
Education pressure: research engineers compete for some technician roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can draw circuits and diagnose common faults, but a technician still needs trained hands and eyes to interpret the burned smell after a prototype fails or an unexplained oscilloscope glitch. AI saves time but cannot replace judgment.

responsibilities: Assemble and solder circuit boards and electrical wiring
Use instruments to test and adjust prototypes
Assist engineers with verification and documentation

career_path_block.说明: 入门岗，自动化替代压力大

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「技能停在十年前」——只会上手测、不会写脚本的技师会被自动化淘汰。往嵌入式、自动化测试、系统集成走，越老越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「被算法顶替的中间层」——接线测试这类标准化技能越来越容易被自动化测试设备和 AI 诊断替代，必须往系统调试、嵌入式、自动化方向升级。
risks: 自动化替代：重复装配测试岗被机器挤压
技能迭代快：不学自动化就被边缘化
项目加班：赶样机赶项目是常态
辐射/静电等环境风险：部分测试环境有害
学历内卷：部分岗位被研发工程师下探挤占

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能画出电路图、自动诊断常见故障，但样机烧了之后闻到的那股糊味、示波器上说不清的那个毛刺，还得靠技师的手和眼睛——机器替你省的是时间，替不了的是判断。

responsibilities: 装配焊接电路板与电气线路
使用仪器测试调试样机
配合工程师完成验证与文档

career_path_block.说明: Small-batch custom work is difficult to automate
Requires additional drawing and process knowledge

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for assemblers is staying limited to assembly. Automation replaces repetitive stations, while workers who can commission and maintain equipment are becoming more valuable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but automation replacing assembly stations. Robot adoption is rising, and highly repetitive, standardized stations face the most pressure. Long hours and repetitive motion also create physical wear that should not be overlooked.
risks: Automation replacement: robots take over standard stations
Repetitive strain: prolonged standing and precision work affect the body
Piece-rate pressure: peak-season overtime and off-season income swings
Advancement ceiling: assembly-only roles offer limited room
Industry relocation: production lines move to lower-labor-cost regions

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can optimize production-line cycle times, but manual precision still determines wire-harness routing and screw torque. That precision is an assembler's durable advantage.

responsibilities: Perform functional tests and quality inspections

career_path_block.说明: 小批量非标，机器难替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 装配工最大的风险不是 AI，而是「只守着装配这一环」——自动化替代的是重复工位，会调试、会维护的装配工反而越来越抢手。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化替代」——装配环节机器人渗透率在上升，重复性高、标准化程度高的工位首当其冲；同时长工时、重复劳动带来的身体损耗也不容忽视。
risks: 自动化替代：标准工位被机器人蚕食
重复劳损：长期站立与精细操作伤身
计件压力：旺季加班、淡季收入波动
晋升瓶颈：纯装配岗位空间有限
行业迁移：产线向低人力成本地区转移

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能优化产线节拍，但「线束怎么走、螺丝拧到多紧」——手上的精度，是机器替不了的装配底气。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but physical and emotional strain. Aides must care for themselves before they can care for others.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI, but physical wear and psychological pressure. Long-term bending and lifting injure the lower back, aging and death cause emotional strain, and pay is generally low.
risks: Frequent bending and lifting create high risk of back injuries
Low income relative to effort
Psychological pressure from aging and death
Pressure from family communication and emotional strain
Professional status and social recognition need improvement

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can record vital signs, remind people to take medication, and call emergency services, but the person who bathes an older adult, dries their hair, and hears them say “thank you” will always be a care aide.

responsibilities: Assist with daily living and personal hygiene
Prepare food and assist with meals
Provide companionship and maintain the environment

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「身体与情绪」——护理员先照顾好自己，才能照顾好别人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「身体损耗与心理压力」——长期弯腰搬抬伤腰，面对衰老与死亡情绪消耗大，且收入普遍不高。
risks: 长期弯腰搬抬，腰背劳损风险高
收入偏低，与付出不匹配
面对衰老与死亡，心理压力大
家属沟通压力，情绪消耗多
职业地位与社会认可度待提升

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能记录体征、提醒用药、呼叫急救，但帮老人洗完澡、吹干头发、听他说一句「谢谢你」的那个人，永远是护理员。

career_path_block.路径: Only runs errands without using data

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but the occupation's danger and pressure. AI can find leads and write reports, but officers themselves always carry on-site danger and enforcement responsibility.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI, but the occupation's inherent danger. Enforcement scenes carry violence risk, while long-term shifts create psychological pressure and occupational illness. Strong public scrutiny and expectations also leave ever less room for error.
risks: Occupational danger: violence risk at enforcement scenes
Shifts and pressure: disrupted schedules and psychological burden
Public scrutiny and accountability: little room for enforcement error
Family sacrifice: holiday duty is routine
Occupational illness: spinal, cardiovascular, and mental health problems

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can predict incidents, identify suspects, and generate reports, but the person on the emergency call faces real danger. Police will always be the ones who respond, speak, and decide.

responsibilities: Conduct case investigations and community policing

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「职业本身的危险和压力」——AI 能帮你找线索、写报告，但现场的危险和执法的责任，永远是警察自己扛。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业本身的危险性」——执法现场有暴力风险，长期倒班、心理压力大、职业病多发；舆情和社会对执法的高要求，也让这份职业的容错空间越来越小。
risks: 职业危险性：执法现场有暴力风险
倒班与压力：作息紊乱、心理负担
舆论与问责：执法容错空间小
家庭牺牲：节假日执勤是常态
职业病：腰椎、心血管与心理问题

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能预判警情、识别嫌疑人、生成报告，但报警电话那头的人正处在真实的风险里，赶过去的、开口说话的、拿主意的，永远是警察。

responsibilities: 开展案件调查与社区警务

career_risk_cards.callout: The risk in this occupation is not AI replacing the role, but standing still. Traditional managers who only schedule guards are losing value. Learn intelligent systems, data-based analysis, and emergency command, and security managers become increasingly indispensable to companies.
career_risk_cards.fact: The role's greatest risk is not AI alone, but responsibility and hybrid capability requirements. When a security incident occurs, emergency command performance can define a career. At the same time, intelligent security systems reduce the value of traditional managers who only schedule guards, while hybrid leaders who understand technical systems and can analyze data are more sought after.
risks: Intelligent security systems replace traditional labor-intensive management models
Accountability for security incident response creates high career risk
Emergency situations are high-pressure and schedules are irregular
Traditional guard-management roles lose value as hybrid requirements rise
Conditions vary substantially by industry, with lower pay in some fields

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can monitor thousands of camera feeds simultaneously, but when an alarm sounds and a crowd panics, people need someone who can calmly direct them toward safety. Security managers carry responsibility not for the system, but for every person's path home.

responsibilities: Develop security management plans and procedures
Coordinate security systems and hazard investigations
Handle security incidents and implement corrective actions

career_risk_cards.callout: 这行的风险不在 AI 取代岗位，而在「原地踏步」——只会管保安排班的传统经理在贬值。把智能系统、数据研判和应急指挥学到手，安全经理反而是企业越来越离不开的角色。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任与复合能力」——安全事件一旦发生，应急指挥的成败就是职业生涯的考验；同时智能安防系统普及，只会「管保安排班」的传统安全经理在贬值，懂技术系统、会数据研判的复合型管理者更吃香。
risks: 智能安防系统替代传统人海管理模式
安全事件处置责任，职业风险大
应急场景高压，作息不规律
传统保安管理岗贬值，复合要求提高
行业差异大，部分领域待遇偏低

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能同时盯住上千路摄像头，但警报响起、人群慌乱的那一刻，需要一个能冷静喊出「往这边撤」的人——安全经理扛的不是系统，是现场每个人回家的路。

responsibilities: 制定安全管理计划与预案
统筹安防系统与隐患排查
处置安全事件并落实整改

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but OTA self-service plus transparent pricing. Pure booking is disappearing while customization and emergency support are gaining value.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is OTA self-service plus AI price comparison. Customers can book standard flights and hotels themselves, eroding the value of pure booking agents. Advisors who can design custom group trips, handle emergencies, and build trust are more secure.
risks: OTA self-service takes standard bookings
AI price comparison compresses commissions
Itinerary disruptions require late-night support
Pure booking loses value
Peak seasons bring high pressure and irregular schedules

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, when an entire family is stranded at a foreign airport and the itinerary falls apart, an advisor still makes late-night calls to coordinate rebooking. People cannot be fully removed from travel support.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「OTA 自助化 + 比价透明」——纯代订在消失，定制兜底在升值。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「OTA 自助化 + AI 比价」——标准机酒自己就能订，纯代订价值被挤压；能做成团定制、会兜底突发、建立信任的顾问更稳。
risks: OTA 自助吃标准单
AI 比价压佣金
行程变动，半夜兜底
纯代订价值被挤
旺季高压，作息乱

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，客人一家困在异国机场、行程全乱，最后还是顾问半夜打电话改签协调——出行这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Uses instruments and develops plans, commanding a premium

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but subsidy fluctuations. Tracking policy cycles and project sources matters more than worrying about robots.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but policy and subsidies. Orders depend heavily on government energy-efficiency funding and fall when policies contract. Aerial work, insulation dust, and confined attic spaces are also serious occupational hazards.
risks: Orders depend heavily on government energy-efficiency subsidy policies
Difficult work in confined spaces such as attics and utility shafts
Insulation dust creates respiratory risks
Exterior work at height creates fall risks
Standardized processes reduce installation-only roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: Employment is primarily project-based. Confirm insurance and workers' compensation terms before work begins. For government-subsidized projects, verify qualification requirements to avoid the risk of advancing project funds.

responsibilities: Perform residential energy assessments and locate weaknesses
Complete sealing, insulation, and ventilation retrofit work
Retest retrofit performance and issue reports
Ensure on-site safety and construction quality
skills: Air leak and thermal imaging diagnostics

career_path_block.说明: 会仪器会定方案，溢价高

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「政策补贴波动」——盯着政策周期和项目来源，比担心被机器人替代更实在。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「政策与补贴」——订单高度依赖政府能效计划拨款，政策一收缩订单就少；高空作业、保温材料粉尘与阁楼狭小空间也是实打实的职业风险。
risks: 订单高度依赖政府能效补贴政策
阁楼管道等狭小空间作业辛苦
保温材料粉尘带来呼吸道风险
高空外墙作业有坠落风险
纯施工岗被标准化流程压缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: 项目制用工为主，开工前确认保险与工伤条款；接政府补贴项目要核实资质要求，避免垫资风险。

responsibilities: 执行住宅节能检测并定位薄弱点
完成密封保温与通风改造施工
复测改造效果并出具报告
保障现场安全与施工质量

career_risk_cards.callout: AI is indeed a risk in this occupation, but only for message-carrying salespeople. Move toward consultative selling, solution development, and customer management. AI can screen leads and remember customers while you invest time in relationships, making you more valuable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is AI. Digital and AI sales tools are restructuring customer leads, quotes, and order processes, replacing representatives who only relay information. Needs insight, relationship maintenance, and complex negotiation, however, still depend heavily on human experience and trust.
risks: AI and digitalization replace message-carrying sales roles
High performance pressure and income volatility
Risk of losing customer relationships
Intensive travel and irregular life
Industry cycles affect order volume

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can screen more than a thousand leads in one day, but a purchasing manager you have worked with for five years still places an order with you first when the budget is tight. No office tool can provide that trust; only repeated customer visits can earn it.

career_risk_cards.callout: 这行的风险确实在 AI——但只针对「传话型销售」。往顾问型、方案型和客户经营上走，AI 帮你筛线索记客户，你把时间花在关系上，反而更值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险正是 AI：客户线索、报价、订单流程正被数字化和 AI 销售工具重构，只做「传话式销售」的代表会被替代；但需求洞察、关系维护、复杂谈判这些环节，依然高度依赖人的经验和信任。
risks: AI 与数字化替代传话型销售
业绩压力与收入波动大
客户资源流失风险
出差强度大，生活不规律
行业周期影响订单量

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能一天筛出上千个线索，但那个合作了五年的采购经理，在预算紧的时候还愿意先给你下个单——这份信任，是坐在办公室的工具给不了的，只能靠你一趟趟拜访换回来。
